about: The page interfaces the engine renamed (round 7 of "Nothing gets worse", 2026-11-25): written from the comparison of the engine's old and new interfaces by AUTOMAT's recipes, never by an AI's fix (tier B). The static guard (tools/fix-guard.py) accepts a new wrap of a property the old script already protects only as a copy of one of its old calls with exactly these names changed, nothing else.
